verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for an email/productivity service, so the story applies. However, the evidence only documents the Microsoft Graph REST mail API, which works from 'any language or platform capable of sending HTTP requests'. That is a developer building block, not an official CLI, and no first-party command-line tool for Outlook appears anywhere in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
